instruction: Adjust GIMP's icon theme to use symbolic icons.

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing GIMP's icon-theme setting to 'Symbolic'. Evaluator uses existing check_config_status metric to verify the 'icon-theme' key in gimprc is set to 'Symbolic'. This is similar in complexity to changing theme - both are preference settings accessible via the same UI path.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement: checks if icon-theme is set to 'Symbolic' in GIMP's gimprc config file
Getter (get_gimp_config_file) correctly extracts the gimprc config file from ~/.config/GIMP/2.10/gimprc
Metric (check_config_status) correctly parses GIMP config format and checks key-value pairs
Expected value format is correct: key='icon-theme', value='"Symbolic"' matches GIMP's config storage format with escaped quotes
Postconfig correctly closes GIMP (Ctrl+Q) to persist changes to gimprc before verification
Complete coverage: evaluator checks the exact requirement stated in the instruction
Data flow is correct: user changes setting → GIMP closes (persisting changes) → getter reads file → metric verifies key-value pair
No logical or semantic issues identified
